name: design-skills-router-workbench
description: Pruebas de la pizarra Design Skills Router

scripts.test: npm run test:core && node tests/router-v12.semantic.cjs release/design-router-pizarra-v1.4.html
scripts.test:browser: node tests/map-test.cjs release/design-router-pizarra-v1.4.html && node tests/router-v12.playwright.cjs release/design-router-pizarra-v1.4.html
scripts.test:preview: python3 -B tools/build.py --output-dir .preview && node tests/router-v12.semantic.cjs .preview/design-router-pizarra-v1.4.html && node tests/map-test.cjs .preview/design-router-pizarra-v1.4.html && node tests/router-v12.playwright.cjs .preview/design-router-pizarra-v1.4.html && node offline/test-offline.cjs .preview/design-router-pizarra-v1.4-offline.html
scripts.test:telemetry: python3 -B -m unittest discover -s telemetry/tests && node --test tests/telemetry-board.test.cjs
scripts.test:telemetry:e2e: python3 -B tools/build.py --output-dir .preview && node tests/telemetry-board.playwright.cjs .preview/design-router-pizarra-v1.4-offline.html && node tests/telemetry-dashboard.playwright.cjs && node tests/telemetry-collector.playwright.cjs
